title: OpenAI's Ad Business Hits $1 Billion Annualized Revenue as ChatGPT Ads Expand Globally
excerpt: ChatGPT advertising reached a billion-dollar run rate after the U.S. pilot generated $100 million in its first six weeks. The Ads Manager has expanded to India, Europe and the Middle East.
body:
• OpenAI's advertising business has reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate, according to Reuters
  • The U.S. pilot hit $100 million annualized revenue within six weeks of launch
  • ChatGPT Ads Manager has expanded to India, Europe, the Middle East and North Africa
  • Analysts say the milestone still falls short of OpenAI's reported $2.5 billion 2026 advertising target

OpenAI's advertising business has reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate, according to Reuters, a milestone that underscores how quickly the AI company has built a commercial ad operation around ChatGPT despite entering the market only months ago.

Rapid Ramp-Up

The company's Ads Manager, which places advertisements on ChatGPT's free and Go tiers, launched with a U.S. pilot that reached $100 million in annualized revenue within just six weeks. OpenAI has since expanded the platform to India, Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, broadening its advertiser base across key growth markets.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=lcuA3DQx27I

The expansion to India is particularly significant given the country's large and growing base of ChatGPT users. Indian advertisers can now bid for placements that appear alongside AI-generated responses, a format that blends search-style advertising with conversational AI.

The Revenue Picture

While the $1 billion milestone is striking for a business that did not exist a year ago, analysts say it still appears short of OpenAI's ambitions. An Emarketer analyst noted that the run rate falls below OpenAI's reported $2.5 billion 2026 advertising revenue target, suggesting the company needs to roughly double its current trajectory by year-end.

OpenAI's broader revenue has been growing rapidly, driven by subscription plans and enterprise API access. The advertising arm represents a new revenue stream that could eventually rival Google's search ad model if ChatGPT continues to absorb queries that would otherwise go to traditional search engines.

Implications for the Industry

The rapid growth of ChatGPT advertising poses a direct challenge to Google, which has dominated digital advertising for two decades. As more users turn to AI chatbots for product research, travel planning and purchase decisions, advertisers are following the eyeballs.

For India's digital advertising market, the expansion means brands can now target ChatGPT's Indian user base directly. Indian tech companies like Wipro, which is simultaneously scaling its own AI capabilities, may find themselves both competing with and advertising through AI platforms.

What's Next

OpenAI is expected to continue expanding its Ads Manager to additional markets and refine its targeting capabilities. The key question is whether conversational AI advertising can sustain premium pricing as the novelty effect fades and advertisers demand the same performance metrics they expect from established platforms.
